nodes.text: Let $q_1<q_2<\cdots$ be a sequence of primes such that\[q_{n+1}-q_n\geq q_n-q_{n-1}.\]Must\[\lim_n \frac{q_n}{n^2}=\infty?\]

#455 : [ErGr80,p.91] number theory Richter [Ri76] proved that\[\liminf_n \frac{q_n}{n^2}>0.352\cdots.\] Additional thanks to : Terence Tao Proof expositions (0) If you would like to contribute an exposition of a proof related to this problem, please message a moderator or leave your exposition as a comment.
